title: Hold to mine
body: Press and hold on a block to keep mining — release when it breaks. Tougher blocks take longer.

title: Proof of Play
body: Every strike runs a real hash. Watch it flash on each hit — that's the proof of your work.

title: Your hotbar
body: Pick what's in your hand with the number keys 1 to 9 or the scroll wheel (on a touchscreen, tap the slots along the bottom).

title: Crafting table
body: Place a crafting table and open it for the full grid — far more recipes than your pocket crafting.

title: Recipe book
body: Stuck on a recipe? Open the recipe book and tap a card to auto-fill the grid.

title: Open your pack
body: Open your inventory to rearrange items, stack things up, and equip armour.

title: See yourself
body: Press F5 to swing the camera out to third person and admire your build — or your outfit.

title: Talk & command
body: Press T (or /) to open chat. Try /time, /gamemode, /give and /help to bend the rules.

title: Don't get lost
body: Press M for the full map. The minimap in the corner fills in as you explore.

title: Ride the rails
body: Lay track, place a cart, and hop in. Depots load and unload chests so your goods ride for you.

title: Chase the Satori
body: The orange gem hides deep in the deepslate — the rarest, toughest material in the world.

title: The Age of Diamonds
body: This frontier runs on diamonds — the old money. Mine them, trade them, hoard them… for now.

title: The first Satori
body: The deepest gem founds your world. Only one Satori is ever the first — the rest are just treasure.

title: A world to found
body: Mine, build, defend, prosper. A civilisation worth its founding isn't built in a day.

title: Build on paper
body: Capture a build with the Drafting Stamp to save it as a reusable blueprint you can stamp down again.

title: Mind the night
body: Mobs spawn in the dark. Plant torches and wall yourself in before the sun goes down.

title: Sneak safely
body: Sneak to step right up to a ledge without falling off — handy when building out over a drop.

title: Take to the air
body: In a Creative world, double-tap Space to fly. Space takes you up and Shift brings you back down.

title: Run, don't walk
body: Double-tap W (or hold Ctrl) to sprint across open ground. Let go of W and you stop.

title: Find any item
body: Press B to search every item in the game. In Creative, click one to put it in your hand.

title: Forgot a key?
body: Press H for a controls cheat-sheet, or open the pause menu with Esc and choose Controls.

title: Watch your landing
body: A fall of more than 3 blocks hurts: half a heart for every extra block. Land in water and it costs you nothing.

title: Hold your breath
body: You can stay underwater for about 15 seconds. Swim up for air before the bubbles run out.
